concepts.name: 银河流光
concepts.detail: Proposal ID "A". A single flowing galactic dust formation bends into a strong M: two upright stellar plumes, two inward-curving luminous dust lanes meeting in a central valley. This is a sculptural galaxy, not a ribbon or rope. Soft organic edges dissolve into microscopic stars, dark dust clouds interrupt the light with genuine depth, a delicate black-glass-like lensing highlight catches only a few forward-facing edges. Compact, rounded shoulders, generously open negative spaces. Near-black dominates, narrow champagne-gold dust lanes create a calm readable gesture. Macro fine-grained long-exposure astrophotographic detail inside a beautifully designed M silhouette.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Melo app identity exploration, one of five separate design proposals.
Primary request: A beautiful compact letter M shaped by DEEP SPACE, STARS and GALACTIC DUST, in a black and muted gold palette. Entirely abandon neural networks: NO connected dots, NO graph lines, NO neurons, NO dendrites, NO molecular model, NO circuit motifs. The creative source is astrophotography and the sculptural optical quality of black ice / smoked Liquid Glass. Calm luxurious design, not a generic AI tech logo.
Shape: a balanced wide capital M with two outer vertical strokes and two inner diagonals descending to a clear central low valley. Readable immediately as M. The letter's shape is created by the cosmic formation or optical phenomenon described below; not a generic font pasted on a galaxy wallpaper. Deep black pockets, extraordinarily fine star grains, dark amber dust and subtle warm champagne starlight. A few icy gray highlights. Strict black/gold/neutral palette, no purple, blue, pink or rainbow nebula.
Material and atmosphere: almost-black translucent depth, selected glasslike refraction or black-ice highlights; sophisticated dark brown-gold interstellar dust with tiny distant stars. Fine detail in a simple coherent silhouette, no noisy spark explosion, no thick gold chrome, no jewelry, no cartoon, no fire or lava.
Presentation: landscape 3:2 concept sheet. Large primary mark on the left two-thirds, same exact mark repeated in two smaller app-icon previews stacked on the right. Both app previews have a glossy translucent black rounded-square tile, with restrained soft optical edge highlights, no metallic gold border. Top preview label "iOS", bottom "macOS". Matching proportions and cosmic mark between both platforms. Backdrop charcoal fading into deep black, no decorative unrelated stars outside the mark. Tiny refined "MELO" wordmark at upper left and exact single-letter proposal ID at bottom left. No other text, no hardware, no fake screens, no watermark.

concepts.name: 黑冰星窗
concepts.detail: Proposal ID "B". A minimal architectural M that feels like a portal cut through translucent smoked black ice into a deep star field. Thick clear optical depth on the outer and inner bevels, rounded corners, broad clean vertical stems and a central deep V. The M itself contains near-black space with tiny warm stars at multiple depths and one subtle amber dust lane. Refraction doubles a few stars along the glass edges; do not cover it in a gold metal outline. The visual identity comes from a dark floating M-shaped window into space, elegant restrained glass volume, not a surface texture. Beautiful small-icon legibility, the quietest and most minimal proposal.

concepts.name: 星尘凝形
concepts.detail: Proposal ID "C". Millions of tiny separate amber-gold and gray stars coalesce into the shape of an M, dense at its four main strokes and fading softly into open edges. No connecting lines. Stars span three depth scales; a few sharp bright stars float in front and tiny dim stars recede very far back. Shape has deliberate organic yet compact geometry, gently flared lower feet and sharp readable central V. Fine black crystalline slivers occasionally refract a star internally, adding a subtle black-ice character without forming a continuous shell. The negative spaces remain dark, so the silhouette reads strongly. Refined compact stellar sculpture with no fireworks, no smoke plume, no surrounding starfield wallpaper.

concepts.name: 深空负形
concepts.detail: Proposal ID "D". A radically graphic negative-space design: two elegant curved compact galaxy clouds flank a clean dark capital M-shaped void. The bright inner edges of the dust formations reveal the M through absence, and the dark M void has subtle smoked-glass optical depth and a few extremely distant tiny gold stars inside. Precise intentional shape with two upright pillars and a clear deep central V, not just two arbitrary galaxy blobs. A restrained amber crescent at each upper shoulder and softly fading granular dust edges. Strong compact logo composition, memorable and quiet, a sculpted dark M made from the space between light. No circular galaxy enclosure, no ring badge.

concepts.name: 冰晶星轨
concepts.detail: Proposal ID "E". A compact geometric M formed by four separate thick-smoked-black-glass optical shards, each slightly rounded and floating with small air gaps at the joints. Within each shard a long-exposure band of miniature warm stars flows along its length; the four bands together trace the M. Segments have visibly different depth and clear refractive edges. Only one narrow gold stellar trail within each dark translucent segment, fine nearby gold dust, no metallic surfaces and no connected-node network. The outer feet are substantial and the central V unmistakable. A carefully designed fragmented black-ice M carrying celestial light, minimal sculptural form with rich internal space.
